title: Suspect dead following confrontation with police in New Bedford
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Crime The suspect allegedly abandoned a child while fleeing officers before entering a Blackmer Street home and opening fire.

A man who allegedly opened fire on New Bedford police officers, fled, and abandoned a child in his vehicle was later found dead inside a home Thursday evening, according to the New Bedford Police Department.
The confrontation prompted police to evacuate nearby residents after the suspect entered a home on Blackmer Street and fired additional shots at officers.
